src/pso/misc/TLobby_802409AC.cpp.source_resolution: Native voice ownership retains the mixer, pitch interpolation, three controller values, stage and split-screen listener, reverb submission and sample lifecycle. The Guild Card response takes the native packet, indexes the original record array and retains card storage, CSV and refresh paths.

src/pso/misc/TLobby_803FC178.cpp.source_resolution: The old aggregate split across the native PPP FSM, LCP, IPCP, PAP, compression, buffers and link providers. Typed callback slots and frame options keep the original handshake, configuration load, timeout, queue and byte-order records.

src/pso/misc/TLobby_804050DC.cpp.source_resolution: The active C units own Ethernet, ARP, route, IP, handler dispatch and resolver state at their original addresses. The DNS request, buffers, embedded result and command tables use their native records and packet release recycles the original pool entry.

src/pso/misc/TLobby_8041112C.cpp.source_resolution: The native packet layout and connection records retain IPv6 dispatch, fragment and neighbor state, loopback and buffer allocation. Shared network destinations feed the two original send dispatchers and the retry and completion paths keep their original callbacks.

src/pso/network/TcpProtocol.cpp.source_resolution: The native C TCP owner retains sequence and idle comparison, typed send and receive buffers, connection state, wait records and receive completion. Window calculations and TCP statistics use the active widths and providers.

src/pso/misc/TLobby_80429598.cpp.source_resolution: The C adapter uses its native descriptor, interrupt state, DMA buffers and send callback. It retains the adapter queue, read and write, receive and transmit interrupts, MAC copy and status at their exact linked addresses, with original boundary widths at EXI.

src/pso/misc/TLobby_80426CAC.cpp.source_resolution: PPPoE uses the original 0xE14-byte session record, named RX/TX buffers and native AC-name and service fields. The typed name and discovery paths keep the exact payload start, TLV cursor, transmit data and state transitions.

src/pso/misc/TPlyJoinLobbyEntry.cpp.source_resolution: The lobby retains typed protocol state and packet receivers, window and keyboard lifecycle, routing and byte swap. The Guild Card user-answer handler is bound using the actual TUserAns callback type at the existing entry address.

include/pso/misc/LobbyNetworkInternal.h.source_resolution: The old network umbrella combines private temporary views and obsolete C++ prototypes. The native PPP state, packet pool, thread and timer dispatch, DNS tables, socket and IPv4/IPv6 owners now provide the ABI. Historical symbols and encoded literal addresses map to active compiled code and data.

src/pso/misc/TCameraCtrl.cpp.source_resolution: The native controller, camera matrix, viewport, target and event records retain the registry, default view, collision and obstruction paths, pose, projection, split-screen and restoration. Spectate input uses the actual controller input record.

src/pso/system/GinjaMaterial.cpp.source_resolution: The renderer retains the original material parameter, vertex array, model and draw list records. The list walker reads those records through const pointers, and keeps the existing generic model queue callback ABI and original GX, alpha, texture and inherited-state paths.

include/pso/misc/TLobby.h.source_resolution: The active lobby header preserves the shared record lookup APIs. The historical class declarations route to the active typed packet, source, render, player and quest owners where those methods moved. String trimming and Guild Card response now have truthful shared declarations under their original linker labels.

src/pso/quest/QuestOpcodeHandlers.cpp.source_resolution: The VM retains the native argument stack and string substitution, typed player inventory, case, save-file and event handlers, and original menu and radar dispatch. Text opcodes pass the actual character array into the shared trim helper before the existing tokenizer.

include/pso/misc/QuestDownloadInternal.h.source_resolution: The download splits own the real input entry, workspace and request, name and text records, cache and pool lists, and bounds and callback declarations. Three older eight-byte storage declarations resolve to four-byte active variables followed by four zero alignment bytes each.

src/pso/misc/TCameraCtrl_native.h.source_resolution: The controller, owner, viewport, placement and matrix headers replace temporary storage and scratch overlays. The native view, active state, camera request, saved state and registry point at the established typed camera and render providers.

src/pso/misc/TLobby_80228818.cpp.source_resolution: The actual floor registry constructor calls its original initialization. TTokenList retains its separate tab and CSV parsers, quote rules, storage, constructor and debug rendering. The original trim label now takes the character buffer that the quest callers pass.

runtime.probe_scope: Executes the original game functions. The mixer control and Guild Card list side effects use hooks. The PPPoE and quest string cases exercise the original memory copies.
